messages:
ashley: Hey sec team — quick ping: PR #4321 updates the auth-proxy so we strip X-Client-Id before forwarding requests to on-prem services. Need a quick security/privacy review + can we slot this for merge in next low-traffic window? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/4321

leo: can you paste the minimal diff or env vars that change? quick glance only

ashley: minimal change, middleware removes forwarded client header for onprem routes. snippet from the proxy middleware:
```
// onprem route handler
req.Header.Del("X-Client-Id")
// then set internal tracing header
req.Header.Set("X-RW-Client-Hash", hashUserID(user.ID))
```

maria: thanks — does this affect audit logs/tracing in onprem? we use X-Client-Id sometimes for correlating requests to traces

ashley: good call. We keep a hashed id for correlation (X-RW-Client-Hash). It's non-reversible and already used in a few internal flows. Also we add an optional X-Orig-Client flag recorded only in internal logs (masked). Example hash function pseudocode included in tests.

sec-scan-bot: sec-scan: PR scanned — no secrets found. Note: KMS path change in terraform detected in module/proxy_kms.tf line 12 — please confirm KMS access review. https://scans.redwood/sec/4321

leo: we should confirm attacker can't inject X-RW-* headers. Is header set server-side only and overwritten if present?

ashley: yes — middleware explicitly unsets any incoming X-RW-* and sets it after auth. code:
```
for k := range req.Header {
  if strings.HasPrefix(k, "X-RW-") { req.Header.Del(k) }
}
if authenticated { req.Header.Set("X-RW-Client-Hash", hash(user.ID)) }
```
unit tests cover this behavior.

maria: also confirm we don't forward Authorization or internal tokens to onprem backends

ashley: confirmed. we Del("Authorization") and Del("X-Internal-Token") for onprem routes. snippet:
```
req.Header.Del("Authorization")
req.Header.Del("X-Internal-Token")
```

tim: quick note from sec-lead: looks aligned. two asks before final LGTM: 1) add a line to the deploy playbook about header masking & rollback steps 2) confirm KMS path ownership (see sec-scan link)

leo: i'll do a quick code review after tests pass. also add a changelog note for infra & privacy teams. what's the canary plan?

ashley: canary plan in PR description: 5% traffic for 2 hours, monitor 500s & trace correlations, automatic rollback on error-rate spike. I've added smoke-tests and e2e asserting header stripping.

sec-scan-bot: checklist update: KMS owner confirmed by @maria. automated tests present. privacy review required.

tim: i'll hold final LGTM pending maria's privacy confirm. maria? @maria

maria: privacy ok — hash is salted and one-way, no PII forwarded. approve from privacy side.

leo: thanks — added changelog entry and smoke note. LGTM from me once CI green.

ashley: awesome, thanks all. I'll schedule merge in the low-traffic slot tomorrow 02:00 UTC and post deployment notes here. :thumbsup:
